description: Complete dry food for adult dogs of small to medium breeds, with high-quality animal protein, a digestive fibre mix and digestible rice, in special dental care kibble.
ingredients_full:
Ingredients:
Dried chicken and turkey [natural source of glucosamine, chondroitin and taurine], lamb (14%), rice (14%), maize, millet, barley, pork fat, dried sugar beet pulp (2.6%), chicken gravy, dried whole egg, linseed, minerals (including 0.35% sodium hexametaphosphate), fructo-oligosaccharides (0.25%, a natural prebiotic), mannan-oligosaccharides (0.13%, a natural prebiotic).
Additives per kg:
Nutritional and physiological additives:
Vitamin A (15,000 IU), vitamin D3 (1500 IU), vitamin E (250mg), beta-carotene (5mg), L-carnitine (50mg), iron [iron (II)-sulphate-monohydrate] (50mg), copper [copper (II)-sulphate-pentahydrate] (8mg), zinc [zinc sulphate monohydrate] (62.5mg), manganese [manganese(II)-sulphate monohydrate] (10mg), iodine [calcium iodate anhydrous] (1.5mg).
Technological additives:
Antioxidants: tocopherol-containing extracts from vegetable oil (25mg).
Sensory additives:
Flavourings: rosemary extract.
